data.name: HowToPlay_RuleA
data.value: The captain will start the first turn by selecting a card from their hand.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleB
data.value: Then, the next player in clockwise order must play a card of the same suit (if they have one), a card of another suit if they do not have the lead suit, or their king card.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleC
data.value: Step b will be repeated until the last player is reached.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleD
data.value: The player who played the highest numbered card of the lead suit will win the trick.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleD_Sub1
data.value: King cards beat any non-king card. They will only lose to another king card according to hierarchy (spades -> hearts -> clubs -> diamonds).

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleE
data.value: The cards won by the player will be moved to their side and cannot be played again.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleF
data.value: The number of tricks played equals the number of cards each player holds (for 3 players, 13 tricks are played). Unless all objectives are completed or one fails; if this happens, the game proceeds to the next mission or restarts it, respectively.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleG
data.value: Communication tokens allow players to reveal a card from their hand by placing the token on their card. Tokens cannot be placed unless one of the conditions described below is met. Depending on where it is placed, it means:

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleG_Sub1
data.value: If the token is placed at the top of the card, it means it is the player's highest card of that suit.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleG_Sub2
data.value: If the token is placed in the center of the card, it means it is the player's only card of that suit.

data.name: HowToPlay_RuleG_Sub3
data.value: If the token is placed at the bottom of the card, it means it is the player's lowest card of that suit.
